comments.body:
It's technically a +453 -12, but practically, it will very probably end up decreasing the amount of duplicated code in HM (and the whole ecosystem) as a result

Haven't checked the implementation, but the idea behind it is really good.
I'm surprised there is no issue linked?
Aren't there any long-standing issue talking about it?

i think over at modular services we've wanted this, yeah - https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#modular-services had a mention of:

> - an option for user services (TBD)
